title: Negative sampling decisions fill the 2-slot annotation store; active requests lose their annotation and tainted findings are dropped
claim: Since 87ecf02 BindScope stores Sampled=false annotations for sampled-out and capacity-dropped scopes against the MaxConcurrentRequests (default 2) bound. Two in-flight sampled-out requests leave an active, permit-holding request with no annotation (tag _dd.iast.enabled=0, no owner binding). NewOrphanTaintedSpan then gets no slot, so the tainted finding is dropped while an empty orphan span is emitted per sink hit. Weak findings are dropped too.

title: Bind/report after root Finish re-creates an open annotation that is never flushed; findings silently lost
claim: Finished deletes the root entry. A later BindScope/AnnotationFor on the finished root (late StartSpanFromContext, weak report) stores a fresh open annotation and rebinds the owner to it. ReportTainted commits into it and returns true, but nothing flushes it. The entry and its source-byte charge persist until the span is GC'd and a trim runs.

title: Second Finish() of a root with a re-created annotation calls SetMetaStruct on a finished span, racing the trace writer
claim: The woven prologue runs Finished on every Span.Finish. After a late report re-creates a sampled annotation (F2), a second Finish() calls span.SetMetaStruct on the already-finished span. dd-trace-go setMetaStructLocked has no finished guard, and the writer encodes finished spans without the span lock. The result is a data race on span.metaStruct (a map write that can race iteration, which is a fatal error) and on the encoded Event.

title: Weak-crypto reports outside any span create and finish one orphan trace span per call before sampling/dedup
claim: Weak-hash hooks pass a nil ctx. Without a context or GLS span, every md5/sha1 call starts and finishes an orphan trace span (59 allocs/call) before the sampling decision. Report has no process-level dedup, so sampled calls re-emit the same finding with ManualKeep, and each orphan transiently occupies an annotation-store slot.

title: Annotation-store capacity check is a TOCTOU; concurrent first binds exceed MaxConcurrentRequests
claim: trimStore() is checked outside LoadOrCompute/LoadOrStore, so concurrent binders of distinct roots all insert. 7 entries were observed with a cap of 2. The overshoot is bounded by concurrency and self-corrects.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -count=1 -v -run TestReviewStoreCapacityTOCTOU ./internal/spans/ (with evidence/life-spans/zz_review_internal_test.go in internal/spans)

title: Real-tracer meta_struct path and lifecycle edges are untested
claim: All spans tests use mocktracer, where SetMetaStruct returns false, so the msgpack meta_struct branch is never exercised. No tests cover default capacity 2 with mixed decisions, post-finish bind/report, double Finish, or concurrent first binds; tests force MaxConcurrentRequests=64.

title: A negative span annotation short-circuits owner fallback in selectTaintedAnnotation
claim: ExistingForSpan returns found=true for a Sampled=false annotation, so taint from another active owner is dropped instead of being reported on the owner's bound span. This behavior is undocumented.

title: RequestTainted is never incremented; request.tainted telemetry always submits 0
claim: Only a test writes RequestTainted. Finished submits request.tainted=0 for every finished annotation, including negative and orphan ones.
